sources.entry: LumiYing - Generates videos and images from text and visual references using multiple AI models in one workspace. #paid

summary.name: LumiYing
summary.one_liner: LumiYing is a paid AI platform that generates videos and images from text prompts and reference media using multiple third-party AI models in one workspace.
use_cases: create social media videos from text
edit or extend existing video clips
compare outputs from different AI models
summary.what_it_does: LumiYing lets users generate AI videos and images from text prompts, product shots, character images, video clips, or audio references in one place. It offers a selection of third-party models (listed on the page include Seedance, Kling, Nano Banana, GPT Image, Midjourney and Seedream) so users can pick a model per job and compare results. Users can configure aspect ratio, resolution, duration and model settings, and reuse references to keep characters or products consistent. Supported models also offer video editing and extension, with available controls depending on the model.
notable: Multiple leading image and video models accessible from one workspace
Reusable reference inputs (images, video, audio) for consistency across generations
Video editing and extension on compatible models
caveats: Credit-based system: different models and resolutions consume different amounts of credits
Supported inputs, file counts, durations and controls depend on the selected model
Processing time varies by model, settings and demand
